newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 16.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 16.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker levels were quoted within the day-earlier range, although a few sellers adjusted prices down late Wednesday, traders said. One to two sellers quoted 380cst at $119-$121 while most were at $122-$123. Some sellers pushed quotes lower in order to cut back their high stocks levels, while others maintained levels in line with firm cargo prices, traders said. Both MDO and gas oil were firm on strong cargo prices. --Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082).
